reviewer_notes: Evidence rows (C026–C035) are mostly sound: the right decision, budgets honoured, no medical or reliability overreach. The weaknesses are in the 15 no-evidence rows, which share one template: a paragraph of 3–6 bundled asks, no quick-reply options, a redundant 'which country?' question (LapFit is India-only) and a closing 'no evidence is supplied here, so I cannot…' disclaimer. Most fail V6 (≤2 questions) and V9. C046 invents a quote. Coverage gaps against the spec: no real multi-turn rows (corrections sit inside one message), no image-described inputs, no off-topic or unsafe requests beyond privacy, only 1 Hinglish row and no Telugu- or Tamil-English, no review records with n owners, and fixture names outside U–Z. All 112 assertions are typed semantic; budget, question-count and language checks should be deterministic.
